name: danger-zone
title: Danger zone
description: The destructive actions of a settings page in one clearly marked section, each with its consequence in words and a confirm step.
docs: Give it actions: id, title, description (the consequence, in words), label (the button), onConfirm (which may return a promise) and optionally confirmation, the name to type before the confirm button works. Each button opens an alert dialog that restates what will happen, with Cancel focused; the dialog stays open while onConfirm runs and shows its rejection in an alert. disabledReason switches a row off and writes the reason under its description, because a disabled button cannot say it. The destructive tone is only in the border and the button labels, and the heading says "Danger zone" in words. dialogTitle, dialogDescription and confirmLabel adjust the dialog; the description in the dialog is plain text or inline elements. labels translates the words.
